items.title: Photorealistic Portrait
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic close-up beauty portrait of a young woman with natural skin texture. Soft diffused studio lighting, minimal makeup. Light blue eyes, straight brows, natural freckles across nose and cheeks, slightly flushed rosy cheeks. Neutral matte lips, relaxed expression, centered framing. Shallow depth of field with sharp focus on eyes and skin details. Clean white background, high-resolution editorial skincare photography style.

items.title: Figure Transformation
items.prompt: Transform the illustration into a photorealistic PVC figure. Keep the original character's design, pose, proportions, and colors exactly the same. Render realistic painted surfaces with detailed shading. Include subtle seam lines typical of manufactured figures. Apply glossy highlights on hair and clothing, matte finish on skin.

items.title: Four Seasons Landscape
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic digital illustration: Historical Asakusa waterfront viewed across the Sumida River towards the futuristic Tokyo Skytree. Depict this scene as a seamless composition cycling through the four seasons from left to right. Left (Winter): Cold snowy landscape, snow-covered historic buildings, icy and cloudy elements. Center-left (Spring): Melting snow, fresh green buds, blooming cherry blossoms. Center-right (Summer): Lush green vegetation, bright sunlight, strong reflections on the river. Right (Autumn): Vibrant golden, orange, red foliage. No visible boundaries between seasons, smooth blending. Cinematic lighting, 8K resolution, highly detailed textures.

items.question: What is Nano Banana AI?
items.answer: Nano Banana AI is the community name for the latest generation of advanced image models, specifically referring to Google Nano Banana (Gemini) technology known for superior reasoning and consistency.

items.question: Is BananaPro free to use?
items.answer: We offer a free tier that lets you explore Nano Banana capabilities. For heavy usage and advanced features, we have affordable subscription plans.

items.question: How does Nano Banana differ from Midjourney?
items.answer: Nano Banana excels at prompt adherence and specific editing tasks like keeping a character's face the same across different poses, which is a key advantage of Google Nano Banana models.

items.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
items.answer: Yes! All images generated via BananaPro come with full commercial rights, so you can use your Nano Banana AI art for any project.

items.question: Do you use official Google Nano Banana models?
items.answer: Yes, our platform is built on top of the authentic Google Nano Banana API to ensure you get the highest quality results possible.

items.question: Is it compatible with other tools?
items.answer: BananaPro creates standard image formats that work with all your favorite design tools and fits perfectly into existing workflows.
